data.title: Ethereum gains nearly 20% in July, outpacing Bi... | Pluang
data.description: Ethereum has surged nearly 20% in July, significantly outperforming Bitcoin's 11.7% gain as ETH trades around $1,880 to $1,970. This rise is driven by increased ETF flows into Ethereum products and higher staking participation, which reduces circulating supply. Meanwhile, Bitcoin remains range-bound between $64,000 and $66,500, with traders cautious amid Federal Reserve interest rate uncertainty. Ethereum's strength may signal a broader altcoin rotation and attract more institutional investment if it breaks above $2,000.
